# Fallback Ubuntu mirrors for CI package installs (.github/scripts/apt-install.sh).
#
# The runner's own Ubuntu sources are tried first. If an install fails there,
# the helper points apt at this list instead, and apt tries these mirrors in
# priority order (without a priority, apt picks mirrors at random). Metadata
# must be separated from the URI by a tab. Azure's cloud mirror, the kernel.org mirror and Princeton's mirror
# run on infrastructure separate from Canonical's archive, which comes last.
#
# Every mirror here must carry the release, -updates, -backports and
# -security suites for amd64. apt checks everything against the Ubuntu
# archive signing key, so a mirror cannot change what gets installed.
http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/	priority:1
https://mirrors.edge.kernel.org/ubuntu/	priority:2
https://mirror.math.princeton.edu/pub/ubuntu/	priority:3
http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/	priority:4
